name: Avatar
summary: A round picture or initials for a person or account, alone or stacked in a group.
description: Put an inside for a photo, or two letters of initials when there is none. Use a group to show who is on a project; show a count instead once it gets past four or five faces.

classes.name: v-avatar
classes.description: A 2.5rem circle with an accent tint for initials. An inside fills and crops to it.

classes.name: v-avatar-square
classes.description: Rounded square, for companies and teams rather than people.

classes.name: v-avatar-group
classes.description: A row of overlapping avatars with a ring in the surface colour; type shrinks so initials are never covered.

a11y: Give a photo a useful alt (the person's name) unless the name is already written next to it; then use alt="".
Initials alone are read letter by letter. When the name is not shown nearby, add it with aria-label or a .v-sr-only span.
Label a group with its meaning, e.g. aria-label="3 team members", on the wrapper.
